purpose: AI 기술·병목·메모리 요구를 기명 플랫폼의 독립 채택 단계와 연결해 직무 질문을 좁힌다. 고객 주문·수요 물량·성능 효과를 입증하는 표가 아니다.

new_sources.title: SK hynix Unveils First HBF Standard Specifications with Sandisk, Presenting AI Memory Solutions at FMS 2026

excerpts.text: new memory layer between HBM and SSDs.
excerpts.locator: Body paragraph beginning HBF technology is; after FMS date paragraph

excerpts.text: first standard specifications for High Bandwidth Flash (HBF)
disclosed through the Open Compute Project (OCP)
excerpts.locator: Body paragraph beginning The specification was disclosed

limitations: The issuer says the specification was disclosed through OCP; the original OCP specification and conformance process were not independently inspected.
Specifications and ecosystem participation are not a qualified customer order or mass-shipment observation.
The separate 375-layer NAND/eSSD future mass-production plan in this article is not an HBF shipment schedule.

join_constraints: Intel 인증 모듈과 Dell 전시 DDR5는 동일 part number·용량 근거 없이 하나의 SKU/주문 경로로 합치지 않는다.
